verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Profile Builder creates customer profiles in the warehouse from `identify` traits. It also documents custom JavaScript logic for profile generation over up to a year of events, which supports computed traits only through code a developer writes. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in predictive scores (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) or a marketer-facing way to use these attributes for targeting or audiences; profiles simply land in the warehouse. Missing for 10: built-in predictive scoring models, no-code computed trait definitions for marketers, audience/targeting activation of profile attributes, independent corroboration.
